subject.title: refactor(macos): move PortGuardian state to SQLite

question: Should OpenClaw accept this macOS-only one-way PortGuardian storage cutover, including fail-closed exclusion of older JSON-writing app copies sharing the same host state directory?
rationale: The implementation intentionally changes supported downgrade and mixed-version behavior for durable host-global tunnel state; code review cannot choose that compatibility contract without maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept the documented cutover
options.body: Approve SQLite-only PortGuardian state with old-copy exclusion after final-head native proof and prerequisite integration are available.

options.title: Defer the cutover
options.body: Keep the current JSON ledger until maintainers define a supported mixed-version or rollback policy.

recommendation.title: Accept the documented cutover
recommendation.body: Approve SQLite-only PortGuardian state with old-copy exclusion after final-head native proof and prerequisite integration are available.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored the active PortGuardian and prerequisite native-state migration stack and can route the documented contract for maintainer acceptance.
